experiment: Exp 17C (Wave 9A, Gate 3): Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 40-layer causal KL, shipped GPTQ vs HF-INT4-G16 / MLX / NVFP4 / SymINT4, MoE BiasCorr policies

meta.gpu: host GPU1 only (/dev/dri/card1 + renderD129, PCI redacted-pci-gpu1), container xpu:0
meta.stream_dtype: BF16 weights and activations; GDN delta rule, norms and router softmax in FP32 as in HF

arm_definitions.quantized_set: identical to the shipped GPTQ coverage: GDN in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/out_proj, attention q/k/v/o_proj, shared expert gate/up/down_proj, all 256 expert gate/up/down per layer. in_proj_a/b, conv1d, GDN norm, router, shared_expert_gate, norms, embeddings, lm_head stay BF16
arm_definitions.ShippedGPTQ: the local checkpoint's integer weights, dequantized to BF16 (W4A16 semantics); its base is a heretic abliteration, not the reference model, so its KL contains the abliteration as well as quantization
arm_definitions.ShippedGPTQ_rank1Restored: exploratory heuristic: GPTQ plus u u^T (W_official - W_gptq) on o_proj, GDN out_proj, shared and expert down_proj, with one shared direction u estimated by the audit. Removes the abliteration only as far as it is rank-1 along u
arm_definitions.BC: delta_b = (W_bf16 - dequant(W)) @ E[x], FP32, position 0 excluded; for experts E[x] is the unweighted mean over calibration positions routed to that expert
arm_definitions.BC_shared_attn_only: every dense linear in the quantized set (attention or GDN, plus shared expert); no routed expert
arm_definitions.BC_all_experts: dense plus every expert with at least 1 routed calibration position
arm_definitions.BC_threshold_64: dense plus experts with at least 64 routed calibration positions
arm_definitions.W4A8: FP32 rotation, per-token absmax/127, int8 x int8 _int_mm, FP32 epilogue, on dense AND experts. v0.2.0 does not run W4A8 on MoE experts; see the denseOnly_expertsW4A16 arm
arm_definitions.Konly_Vonly: HF-INT4-G16 on only self_attn.k_proj or only v_proj in the 10 full-attention layers
arm_definitions.HF_INT4_G16: weights quantized with the v0.2.0 plugin's own _q_u_from_logical/signs/Hadamard rule; every quantized K here is a multiple of 128, so Had64 is never used

meta.kl_repeat_noise: 0.0 exactly: BF16_patched_zero_bias is an independent second BF16 stream and its KL is asserted to be 0

corpus.window_layout: 4 windows x 512 raw token ids per eval domain, no BOS; positions 0..510 predict tokens 1..511 (511 per window, 2044 per domain)
corpus.calibration_layout: 4 x 512 WikiText-2 TRAIN (walking back from the end) + 4 x 512 _pydecimal.py (walking forward from token 512); position 0 of each window excluded from every E[x] (4088 positions)

ood_source.layout: interleaved gsm8k, mmlu, humaneval rendered with the model's chat template (default thinking mode), concatenated until 512 tokens, one window per fresh group

meta.bootstrap: export_biascorr.blk32_ci: 32-position blocks resampled within each 511-position window, 10000 resamples, seed 20261125

hf_int4_g16_projection.formula: per N x K quantized matrix: q_pack N*K/2 + u_pack N*(K/64)*2 + d_row 4N + bias_corr 4N bytes; everything else BF16

kv_state_model_theoretical.note: model arithmetic only; vLLM's block allocation for hybrid state and runtime buffers were not measured

abliteration_fingerprint.estimator: leading eigenvector of sum(lambda1 * u1 u1^T) over the 40 mlp.experts.down_proj residuals (W_official - dequant(GPTQ))

B_hf_full_depth.reference: HF Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM.forward; decoder layers loaded by our reader only while HF's own loop calls them

ShippedGPTQ.reason: deliberately never saved: the correction is computed against the official base, which is not this checkpoint's base, so it also moves the abliterated weights back toward the original model on the calibration mean

per_position.layout: arm -> domain; row-major 4 windows x 511 scored targets
